simple.meaning: to strike down; by implication, to hammer , stamp , conquer , disband

definitions.short: to strike down; by implication, to hammer , stamp , conquer , disband
definitions.usage: beat (down), break (down), overcome, smite (with the hammer).
definitions.full: H1986. halam [ הָלַם ] verb smite, hammer, strike down (compare Phoenician מהלם below below מַהֲלֻמוֺת ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular וְהָֽלְמָה consecutive Judg 5:26 ; 3 plural הָֽלְמוּ 5:22 ; Isa 16:8 ; suffix הֲלָמוּנִי Prov 23:25 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יֶהֶלְמֵנִי Psa 141:5 ; 3 masculine plural יַהֲלֹמ֑וּן 74:6 ; Participle active מָּ֑עַם ה֫וֺלָם Isa 41:7 (compare Ges § 29 , 3 b); passive construct הֲלוּמֵי 28:1 ; — smite (with hammer), followed by accusative of person Judg 5:26 (fatally; || מָחַץ מָחַק, ); also figurative of correction, discipline Psa 141:5 (|| הוֺכִּיחַ ); of intoxicating, wine שְׂרוּקֶּיהָ הָֽלְמוּ גוֺיִם בַּעֲלֵי שִׂבְמָה גֶּפֶן Isa 16:8 the vine of Sibma, its choice branches smote down lords of nations (so Hi De Che Brd Di and others, RVm; lords subject according to Ges Ew and others AV RV); also יַיִן הֲלוּמֵי smitten down by wine 28:1 ; compare further Prov 23:35 ; followed by accusative of thing ה֫וֺלָםמָּֿ֑עְם Isa 41:7 one striking an anvil; smite down , or strike off Psa 74:6 (object פִתּוּחִים carved work ); also absolute of horse' hoofs Judg 5:22 . — On וַהֲלֹם 1Sam 14:16 see הֲלֹם .
